title: Phase 12A server-owned verified output and canonical citations

nodes.label: External consumer / LLM proposal-only
nodes.locator: external consumer; outside MAX Grounding source

edges.action: submit bounded candidate claims and opaque server-issued evidence refs; no caller-authored graph or citations
submit the same bounded proposal through MCP
authenticate, validate bounded request, delegate verification
validate tool input and delegate to the same service method
resolve opaque refs only from MAX Grounding server-owned evidence
construct assertions and quality/provenance from resolved server-owned evidence
deterministically classify bounded claims and attach claim-level citations
serialize verifications, canonical citations, synthesis claims, and blocked claims
unknown, forged, expired, or altered ref returns bounded rejection; no partial packet
SUPPORTED only enters synthesis_claims; PARTIAL / CONFLICTED / UNSUPPORTED remain blocked
consumer treats only server-returned synthesis_claims and canonical citations as authoritative facts

authority_invariants: External LLM is candidate-proposal-only and never evidence authority.
MAX Grounding server-owned fetched evidence is the evidence and citation authority.
Unknown or fabricated evidence reference fails closed.
Only SUPPORTED claim enters the synthesis-safe packet; partial, conflicted, and unsupported claims are blocked.
